capabilities: Expand short triggers into Markdown while typing
Search and insert snippets from a picker
Install, mute or delete snippet packs
disambiguation: Not a code-snippet or CSS-snippet manager; it expands typed triggers into text inside notes.
extras: No analytics, telemetry or account; the plugin goes online only when the Packages page is opened, to fetch the catalog from GitHub, and snippets are stored in the plugin's data.json. Importers exist for Text Snippets and Espanso, but not for Substitutions settings.
intentEvidence: Espanso, Raycast, Keyboard Maestro and AutoHotkey work in every app, and Snipsy works only in Obsidian.
problem: Common Markdown structures, symbols and phrases have to be typed out in full, and system-wide text expanders are not aware of Markdown context such as code blocks, math and frontmatter.

relations.evidence: One difference: Snipsy expands as you type instead of waiting for a key.
Espanso, Raycast, Keyboard Maestro and AutoHotkey work in every app, and Snipsy works only in Obsidian.
the typography set is ported from its 32 default rules

summary: Text expander that turns short triggers and regex patterns into Markdown as you type, with a searchable snippet picker and installable packs.
